description_en: Updates the publishing status of a media file
name: UpdateMediaPublishState

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media file whose publishing status you want to update. You can obtain the ID of a media file from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44458.html operation. Alternatively, perform the following operations in the ApsaraVideo Media Processing (MPS) console: In the left-side navigation pane, choose Media Management > Media List. Find the required video and click Manage. The ID of the video is displayed on the Basics tab
parameters.help_zh: 需更新发布状态的媒体ID。可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44458.html的返回参数中获取，也可以登录媒体处理控制台，通过**媒体管理** > 媒体列表找到目标视频，单击管理，从目标视频的基础信息页签获取
parameters.name: media_id

parameters.help_en:
The publishing status. Default value: Initialed. Valid values:

true: published.
false: unpublished
parameters.help_zh:
发布状态。默认值：Initialed（初始）。可选范围：
true：发布。
false：不发布
parameters.name: publish
